## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Compatibility

- [ ] The stable `openai_oauth_conversation` domain is unchanged.
- [ ] Existing config entries, unique IDs, and action names remain compatible, or the migration is documented and tested.

## Validation

- [ ] Tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `ruff format --check .` passes.
- [ ] `ruff check .` passes.
- [ ] `pytest` passes.
- [ ] Documentation and changelog were updated when needed.
- [ ] No credentials, callback URLs, private prompts, attachments, generated content, or `.storage` data are included.
